findings.summary: Step 4.7 names the snapshot by wall clock; emit_pressure_state looks it up by nominal tick.
findings.this_tick: wrote docs/data/cycle-snapshot-07:05.json against nominal tick 07:00 -> cycle_snapshot_promoted:false
findings.NEW_DETAIL: The defect is not only the FILENAME. The fence passes --arg tick "$FILE_TICK" too, so the .tick FIELD INSIDE the file is also wall-clock: this tick's file carries tick:"07:05" when the nominal tick is 07:00. A fix that renames the file but leaves the field would still miss a content-based lookup. Prior 4 reports said 'named by wall clock' and understated it.
findings.deterministic: FILE_TICK=$(date -u +%H:%M) is pure bash inside the fence — no LLM substitution involved, so this fires identically on every tick regardless of dispatcher.
findings.executed_as_written: Ran the fence verbatim rather than hand-substituting a nominal name. Hand-correcting would break the evidence chain and is an unrecorded flow edit; the router does not edit flow docs.
findings.fix: docs/agents/cowork-team/flow/tick-snapshot.md — FILE_TICK must be the nominal tick, used for BOTH the filename and the --arg tick value. No server change.

findings.summary: Step 5.1's LOAD_1MIN parse splits on the decimal comma under the live fr_FR locale and truncates.
findings.measured_this_tick: uptime emitted 'load averages: 3,62 3,36 3,13'; the flow-as-written pipeline returned 3; true value 3.62.
findings.both_locales_wrong: fr_FR truncates at the decimal comma (3,62 -> 3). LC_ALL=C removes the commas the -F',' split depends on and concatenates all three averages instead. Pinning LC_ALL=C is NOT the fix — it is a second bug.
findings.verified_fix: uptime | awk -F'load averages?:' '{print $2}' | awk '{v=$1; gsub(",",".",v); print v}' — yields 3.62 under both locales.
findings.why_it_matters_now: While pressure_mode was legacy, HEADROOM_MB was forced null so DEGRADED was true regardless and this parse never changed an outcome. Under adaptive with headroom 5128 >= floor 1500, the load half is the sole remaining determinant of DEGRADED.
findings.fails_open: Both failure modes bias toward max_parallel_default=4, never toward throttling: the truncated integer is always <= true load, and the concatenated string never satisfies a numeric > against the threshold.
